_comment: Lists the image assets that actually exist. The game preloads these at boot; renderers fall back to the procedural look for anything not listed. kind: 'texture' (tileable pattern) or 'sprite' (transparent PNG). Optional per-texture: opacity (0-1), blend (canvas composite op e.g. 'screen','overlay','soft-light','multiply'), scale (image-px to world-units multiplier).
